title: KMS/HSM telemetry bridge Terraform module: healthchecks, metrics, and upgrade-safe wiring
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a Terraform module that wires KMS/HSM integrations into Redwood Private deployments with first-class telemetry and automated health checks. The module should: (1) provision resource wiring for HSM-backed key proxies and KMS provider configuration, (2) attach healthcheck and metrics exporters that map HSM/KMS telemetry to the Redwood Console (Prometheus/OTLP), and (3) provide upgrade-safe primitives (rolling-replace, dual-write toggles, canary metrics) so secrets and keys can be migrated with minimal disruption. This ticket focuses on the infra/TF module and healthcheck design; separate tickets will cover operator/controller implementation and Vault/Secrets Manager runtime adapters.
design_notes:
- We will not bake Vault-specific logic into the module; instead the module exposes outputs (kms_endpoint, tls_secret_arn, healthcheck_endpoint, metrics_config) that Vault/Secrets Manager modules can consume.
- Healthcheck design: a small proxy sidecar or managed lambda that regularly performs a cryptographic sign/verify and key-encrypt/decrypt using a non-privileged key handle to validate both HSM liveness and KMS RPC health. Results emitted as success/error counters and latency histograms.
- Telemetry: prefer OTLP exporter by default with an option to fallback to Prometheus scrape; metrics include: sign_success_total, sign_error_total, last_key_version, key_rotation_in_progress, key_ops_latency_ms_bucket.
- Upgrade safety: provide a dual-write toggle (primary=HSM, secondary=cloud-kms) and a canary label so Console can run equality checks during cutovers. Rolling upgrades should support drain windows and health thresholds to pause or roll back.
implementation_plan:
- Phase 1 (TF module skeleton): variables, outputs, provider compatibility matrix (aws/gcp/azure), and basic resources for KMS endpoint wiring.
- Phase 2 (healthchecks + telemetry): add managed healthcheck lambda or sidecar blueprint, metrics exporter config, and example wiring with Vault.
- Phase 3 (upgrade primitives): dual-write flags, canary labels, and example migration plan in runbook.
- Pull requests: create feature branch in infra-modules repo, open PR referencing this ticket, include unit tests and example deployment.
- Rollout: test in staging private deployment, run a migration canary, validate metrics parity, then schedule production rollout with SRE on-call present.
